name: exp_dust_line_16
description: Redstone Experiments: dust line 16, the same build as `dust_line_16` in a world with the redstone_experiments feature on, so dust uses the experimental evaluator. A lever feeding 16 redstone dust in a line into a lamp. Power drops by one per wire, so the last wire gets 0 and the lamp stays off. Then the lever turns off and the line fades.
